description: Ask the owner to open a successor VerificationRound after a finalized round of your Goal. Call it from your Run's tool context when your grant includes request_recheck and the round's result should be examined again; the owner applies the same admission and shared cap as an automatic recheck and does not run the check itself. Under every-step confirmation the call returns a rework-request card instead of opening the round, and the person's approval applies it as an agent. Parameters name the predecessor round and the reason; onlyIfSourceChanged narrows admission to a source that changed, and acknowledgement is set only when this request answers a Session message.

parameters.predecessorRoundRef: The finalized round whose successor should run.
parameters.predecessorRoundRef.goalId: The round's goal id; it must be your Goal.
parameters.predecessorRoundRef.runId: The Run id the round belongs to.
parameters.onlyIfSourceChanged: When true, the owner opens a successor only if the source changed since the predecessor; omit for the owner's default.
parameters.reason: Why the result should be examined again; the owner's reason text.
parameters.acknowledgement: The Session message this request answers, when it is an answer to a message; omit otherwise.
parameters.expected: The exact W1 version pins the caller saw for this recheck; omit a pin rather than guessing a fresh revision. The predecessor round revision comes from its own `look_graph` VerificationRound card (the Task card's `checks` relation names the rounds), not from the Goal or Task card. The optional TaskReworkRefusal pin is the current reverify refusal record, when one was shown.
parameters.expected[].ref: One of the caller-visible refs this recheck pins: VerificationRound | TaskReworkRefusal (reverify).
parameters.expected[].revision: The exact version the caller saw for `ref`; the owner rejects a mismatch with the current record.
